description: This PHP source file defines a class 'chart' responsible for generating resource allocation charts (weekly, monthly, quarterly) in a project management context, including methods for date calculations, rendering HTML tables, and processing project, user, and contact data.

classes.name: chart
classes.description: Class responsible for generating project resource visualization charts with multiple view types, handling date computations, and rendering HTML output for resource assignments over time.

methods.name: year_quarter
methods.description: Returns a nested array of years, quarters, and corresponding month short names between two dates.

methods.name: year_week
methods.description: Returns a nested array of years, months, and weeks between two dates.

methods.name: year_month
methods.description: Returns a nested array of years, months, and days with day initials between two dates.

methods.name: get_weeks
methods.description: Returns an array of week numbers between two dates.

methods.name: count_months
methods.description: Checks if a given day offset from start falls within the same month and year, returning -1 if not.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates total days between two dates.

methods.name: get_week_dates
methods.description: Returns the start and end dates of a week given the start date and week offset.

methods.name: get_month_dates
methods.description: Returns the first and last date of a month offset from the start date.

methods.name: get_date
methods.description: Gets a date string offset by days from the start date.

methods.name: check_weekend
methods.description: Determines if a date is on a weekend, today, or a weekday, considering user's timezone.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Outputs the difference between two dates in years, months, and days.

methods.name: get_cell_class
methods.description: Returns CSS class 'd' for duplicate days or 'h' for non-duplicates based on input days count.
